# 1. Setup

## - Setting work directories

Defining work directory within rmarkdown chunk

```{r setup, include=TRUE}
local_wd_folder = dirname(dirname(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = local_wd_folder)
```

```{r}
setwd(local_wd_folder)
```

## - Setting seed

This step ensures reproducibility in randomized processes

```{r}
set.seed(seed = 123, kind = "Mersenne-Twister", normal.kind = "Inversion")
```

## - Options

```{r}
options(Seurat.object.assay.version = 'v3')
```

## - Loading libraries

```{r}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(Seurat)
library(scuttle)
library(scater)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(R.utils)
library(gridExtra)
library(scDblFinder)
library(Biostrings)
library(Rsamtools)
```

## - Defining input data and output directories

```{r}
data_folder = paste0(local_wd_folder, '/Data/10x')
results_folder = paste0(local_wd_folder, '/Results/10x')
Input_data = paste(data_folder, '/Per_Sample_Demultiplexed_Mapped_Data', sep = '')

dir.create(path = paste(results_folder, '/VDJ', sep = ''), showWarnings = F)
```

## - Loading palettes

```{r}
# Load additional colour palette packages
library(unikn, quietly = TRUE)
library(RColorBrewer, quietly = TRUE)
library(yarrr, quietly = TRUE)
library(scales, quietly = TRUE)
library(ggsci, quietly = TRUE)

# Define a set of custom color palettes from the unikn package
mix_1 <- usecol(pal = c(Karpfenblau, "white", Peach), n = 15)
mix_2 <- usecol(pal = c(rev(pal_seeblau), "white", pal_pinky))
mix_3 <- usecol(pal = c(rev(pal_bordeaux), "white", pal_petrol), n = 15)

# Display the custom palettes
seecol(list(mix_1, mix_2, mix_3), col_brd = "white", lwd_brd = 4, title = "Comparing palettes mixed from unikn colors", pal_names = c("mix_1", "mix_2", "mix_3"))

# Define a second set of custom palettes from the RColorBrewer and yarrr packages
brew_mix <- usecol(c(rev(brewer.pal(n = 4, name = "Reds")), "white", brewer.pal(n = 4, name = "Blues")), n = 13)
brew_ext <- usecol(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "Spectral"), n = 12)
yarrr_mix <- usecol(c(piratepal("nemo"), piratepal("bugs")))
yarrr_mod <- usecol(c(piratepal("ipod")), n = 9)

gradient_exp <- rev(c('#FFAB01', '#FC8805', '#FC5D05', '#D92211', "#D9043D", "#A6036D", "#7C038C", "#5503A6", "#A69AEE", '#D9D4F7', "#FFFFFF", "#F4F7FF", '#E9EBEF'))

# Display the second set of custom palettes
seecol(pal = list(brew_mix, brew_ext, yarrr_mix, yarrr_mod), col_brd = "white", lwd_brd = 2, title = "Using usecol() and seecol() to mix and modify palettes", pal_names = c("brew_mix", "brew_ext", "yarrr_mix", "yarrr_mod"))

# Define additional custom palettes from the scales package
natjournals_palette <- pal_npg("nrc")(10)
```

# 2. INPUT: Importing pre-filtered samples

```{r}
Merged.SeuratObj <- readRDS(paste(data_folder, 'SC_Objects', 'Added_ADT.rds', sep = '/'))
```

# 3. Loading per sample barcodes from ADT data

```{r}
sample_list <- list()
all_samples <- list.files(Input_data, full.names = TRUE)

for (n in 1:length(all_samples)) {
  sample_list[[basename(all_samples[[n]])]] <- file.path(all_samples[[n]])
}
```

```{r}
ADT_count_matrices <- list()
sample_names <- c()

for (sample in names(sample_list)) {
  dir <- sample_list[[sample]]
  sample_names[[sample]] <- sample
  ADT_count_matrices[[sample]] <- Seurat::Read10X(data.dir = dir)[['Antibody Capture']]
  rm(dir)
}
```

```{r}
for (count.mat in names(ADT_count_matrices)) {
  
  index <- match(count.mat, names(ADT_count_matrices))
  updated_barcodes_names <- paste(paste(substring(colnames(ADT_count_matrices[[count.mat]]),0,16),sep=""),'__', sample_names[index], sep = "")
  colnames(ADT_count_matrices[[count.mat]]) <- updated_barcodes_names
  
}
```

```{r}
bc_rename_dfs <- data.frame(
  renamed_bc  = character(),
  original_bc = character(),
  sample_name = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (count.mat in names(ADT_count_matrices)) {

  index <- match(count.mat, names(ADT_count_matrices))

  original_bc <- colnames(ADT_count_matrices[[count.mat]])

  sample_name_i <- as.character(sample_names[[index]])

  renamed_bc <- paste0(substr(original_bc, 1, 16), "__", sample_name_i)

  bc_df <- data.frame(
    renamed_bc  = renamed_bc,
    original_bc = original_bc,
    sample_name = sample_name_i,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  rownames(bc_df) <- bc_df$renamed_bc

  bc_rename_dfs <- rbind(bc_rename_dfs, bc_df)
}

bc_rename_dfs_filtered <- bc_rename_dfs %>% filter(renamed_bc %in% colnames(Merged.SeuratObj))

Run_S1081_L364A_bcs <- bc_rename_dfs_filtered %>% filter(sample_name %in% c('VA013_T5_GB', 'VA013_T5_ASB', 'VA013_T5_Ambiguous',
  'VA022_T5_GB', 'VA022_T5_ASB', 'VA022_T5_Ambiguous',
  'VA035_T5_GB', 'VA035_T5_ASB', 'VA035_T5_Ambiguous'))

Run_S1146_L364B_bcs <- bc_rename_dfs_filtered %>% filter(sample_name %in% c('VA013_T8_GB', 'VA013_T8_ASB', 'VA013_T8_Ambiguous',
  'VA022_T8_Ambiguous',
  'VA035_T8_GB', 'VA035_T8_ASB', 'VA035_T8_Ambiguous'))

Run_S1146_L364C_bcs <- bc_rename_dfs_filtered %>% filter(sample_name %in% c('VA025_T8_GB', 'VA025_T8_ASB', 'VA025_T8_Ambiguous',
  'VA038_T8_GB', 'VA038_T8_ASB', 'VA038_T8_Ambiguous',
  'VA059_T8_GB', 'VA059_T8_ASB', 'VA059_T8_Ambiguous'))

Run_S1146_L364D_bcs <- bc_rename_dfs_filtered %>% filter(sample_name %in% c('VA025_T5_GB', 'VA025_T5_ASB', 'VA025_T5_Ambiguous',
  'VA038_T5_GB', 'VA038_T5_ASB', 'VA038_T5_Ambiguous',
  'VA059_T5_GB', 'VA059_T5_ASB', 'VA059_T5_Ambiguous'))

Runs_bc <- list('Run_S1081_L364A' = Run_S1081_L364A_bcs,
                'Run_S1146_L364B' = Run_S1146_L364B_bcs,
                'Run_S1146_L364C' = Run_S1146_L364C_bcs,
                'Run_S1146_L364D' = Run_S1146_L364D_bcs)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Biostrings)
  library(Rsamtools)
  library(data.table)
})

# Map renamed barcode -> Identity (swap Identity for any meta column you want)
id_map <- setNames(
  Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data$Identity,
  rownames(Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data)
)

merged_fasta <- DNAStringSet()
merged_annot <- NULL
all_run_summ <- list()

for (run in names(Runs_bc)) {

  # -----------------------------
  # Paths
  # -----------------------------
  in_fasta <- file.path(
    data_folder,
    "Per_ChromiumLane_Mapped_Data", run, "outs/multi/vdj_b/all_contig.fasta"
  )
  in_annot <- file.path(
    data_folder,
    "Per_ChromiumLane_Mapped_Data", run, "outs/multi/vdj_b/all_contig_annotations.csv"
  )

  out_fasta <- file.path(results_folder, paste0("VDJ/", run, "_all_contig.fasta"))
  out_annot <- file.path(results_folder, paste0("VDJ/", run, "_all_contig_annotations.csv"))

  # per-run QC/drop summary
  out_summ <- file.path(results_folder, paste0("VDJ/", run, "_qc_summary.csv"))

  dir.create(dirname(out_fasta), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # -----------------------------
  # Run-specific mapping: original_bc -> renamed_bc
  #   original_bc format: "<barcode_base>__<sample_label>"
  # -----------------------------
  run_bcs <- Runs_bc[[run]]
  map_vec <- setNames(run_bcs$renamed_bc, run_bcs$original_bc)

  # Build bc_base -> sample_label dictionary from run_bcs$original_bc
  map_bc_base <- sub("__.*$", "", run_bcs$original_bc)
  map_sample  <- sub("^.*__", "", run_bcs$original_bc)

  bc_to_sample <- tapply(map_sample, map_bc_base, function(z) unique(z))
  ambig <- names(bc_to_sample)[vapply(bc_to_sample, length, integer(1)) > 1]
  if (length(ambig) > 0) {
    message("WARNING: barcodes with >1 sample_label in run ", run,
            " (showing up to 10): ", paste(head(ambig, 10), collapse = ", "))
  }
  # choose first label if ambiguous (switch to stop() if you want strict)
  bc_to_sample <- sapply(bc_to_sample, `[`, 1)

  # =========================================================
  # ANNOTATIONS CSV (load early for QC classification)
  # =========================================================
  ann0 <- data.table::fread(in_annot)

  # normalize barcode base from annotations
  ann0[, bc_base := sub("-1$", "", barcode)]

  # =========================================================
  # FASTA (read + duplicate handling + classification)
  # =========================================================
  x0 <- Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(in_fasta)
  if (length(x0) == 0) stop("Input FASTA empty/unreadable: ", in_fasta)

  hdr0 <- names(x0)

  # Handle duplicate headers: drop only if identical sequences; else make unique
  tab <- table(hdr0)
  dup_hdrs <- names(tab)[tab > 1]

  removed_identical_dup_headers <- character(0) # dropped
  made_unique_headers <- character(0)           # not dropped, but renamed

  x <- x0
  hdr <- hdr0

  if (length(dup_hdrs) > 0) {
    keep_idx <- rep(TRUE, length(x))

    for (h in dup_hdrs) {
      idx <- which(hdr == h)
      seqs <- as.character(x[idx])

      if (length(unique(seqs)) == 1) {
        # identical sequences -> drop all but first
        keep_idx[idx[-1]] <- FALSE
        removed_identical_dup_headers <- c(removed_identical_dup_headers, rep(h, length(idx) - 1))
      } else {
        # same header but different sequences -> keep all but make names unique
        names(x)[idx] <- make.unique(rep(h, length(idx)), sep = "_dup")
        made_unique_headers <- c(made_unique_headers, rep(h, length(idx)))
      }
    }

    x <- x[keep_idx]
    hdr <- names(x)
  }

  # Parse FASTA barcode + contig suffix from current headers
  fasta_barcode <- sub("(_contig_\\d+.*)$", "", hdr)           # e.g. AAAG...-1
  fasta_suffix  <- sub("^.*(_contig_\\d+.*)$", "\\1", hdr)     # e.g. _contig_1
  fasta_bc_base <- sub("-1$", "", fasta_barcode)

  # Build composite key per contig
  fasta_sample_for <- unname(bc_to_sample[fasta_bc_base])
  fasta_key <- ifelse(is.na(fasta_sample_for),
                      NA_character_,
                      paste0(fasta_bc_base, "__", fasta_sample_for))

  # Lookup renamed barcode
  fasta_renamed <- unname(map_vec[fasta_key])

  # Classification BEFORE filtering
  reason <- rep(NA_character_, length(fasta_bc_base))
  reason[is.na(fasta_sample_for) & !(fasta_bc_base %in% names(bc_to_sample))] <- "unmapped_barcode_not_in_Runs_bc"
  reason[is.na(fasta_sample_for) &  (fasta_bc_base %in% names(bc_to_sample))] <- "unmapped_missing_sample_label"
  reason[!is.na(fasta_sample_for) & !(fasta_key %in% names(map_vec))]         <- "unmapped_key_not_in_map_vec"
  reason[!is.na(fasta_sample_for) &  (fasta_key %in% names(map_vec)) & is.na(fasta_renamed)] <- "unmapped_map_vec_na"
  reason[!is.na(fasta_renamed)] <- "kept_mapped"

  keep_fasta <- (reason == "kept_mapped")

  message("Run ", run, " | FASTA kept after mapping: ", sum(keep_fasta), "/", length(keep_fasta))
  if (sum(keep_fasta) == 0) {
    message("Example FASTA base barcode: ", fasta_bc_base[1])
    message("Example inferred key: ", fasta_key[1])
    message("Example mapping key: ", head(names(map_vec), 1))
    stop("All FASTA contigs filtered out after mapping in run ", run)
  }

  # Join reason to annotations by contig_id (constructed in original style)
  contig_id_from_fasta <- paste0(fasta_barcode, fasta_suffix)

  reason_dt <- data.table(
    run_id = run,
    contig_id = contig_id_from_fasta,
    bc_base = fasta_bc_base,
    reason = reason
  )

  qc_dt <- merge(
    reason_dt,
    ann0[, .(contig_id, barcode, is_cell, high_confidence, productive, chain, length, reads, umis)],
    by = "contig_id",
    all.x = TRUE
  )

  # Summary counts by reason
  summ_reason <- qc_dt[, .N, by = .(run_id, reason)][order(run_id, -N)]

  # QC breakdown for unmapped categories
  qc_break <- qc_dt[reason != "kept_mapped",
                    .(
                      N = .N,
                      is_cell_true = sum(is_cell == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
                      high_conf_true = sum(high_confidence == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE),
                      productive_true = sum(productive == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
                    ),
                    by = .(run_id, reason)][order(run_id, -N)]

  # Duplicate bookkeeping from FASTA header handling
  dup_stats <- data.table(
    run_id = run,
    reason = c("dropped_duplicate_identical_sequence", "kept_header_made_unique_due_to_sequence_diff"),
    N = c(length(removed_identical_dup_headers), length(unique(made_unique_headers)))
  )

  # Assemble QC summary (single file, stacked sections)
  summ_out <- rbindlist(
    list(
      summ_reason[, .(run_id, metric = "fasta_contigs_by_reason", reason, value = N)],
      qc_break[, .(run_id, metric = "unmapped_qc_counts", reason,
                   value = N, is_cell_true, high_conf_true, productive_true)],
      dup_stats[, .(run_id, metric = "fasta_duplicate_handling", reason, value = N)]
    ),
    use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE
  )

  data.table::fwrite(summ_out, out_summ)

  # -----------------------------
  # Write per-run FASTA (mapped only) + index
  # -----------------------------
  x_out <- x[keep_fasta]
  names(x_out) <- paste0(fasta_renamed[keep_fasta], fasta_suffix[keep_fasta])

  # faidx requires unique names
  if (anyDuplicated(names(x_out)) > 0) {
    dn <- unique(names(x_out)[duplicated(names(x_out))])
    message("Duplicate contig names AFTER renaming in run ", run, " (up to 20):")
    message(paste(head(dn, 20), collapse = "\n"))
    stop("Cannot index FASTA: duplicated contig headers after renaming in run ", run)
  }

  Biostrings::writeXStringSet(x_out, out_fasta, format = "fasta", width = 80)
  Rsamtools::indexFa(out_fasta)

  merged_fasta <- c(merged_fasta, x_out)

  # =========================================================
  # ANNOTATIONS CSV (update + write mapped-only)
  # =========================================================
  ann <- copy(ann0)

  # infer sample_label per barcode base
  ann[, sample_label := unname(bc_to_sample[bc_base])]

  # build composite key and map to renamed barcode
  ann[, key := ifelse(is.na(sample_label), NA_character_, paste0(bc_base, "__", sample_label))]
  ann[, renamed_bc := unname(map_vec[key])]

  # keep only mapped rows (consistent with FASTA output)
  ann <- ann[!is.na(renamed_bc)]

  # update barcode
  ann[, barcode := renamed_bc]

  # update contig_id: keep "_contig_X" suffix but replace barcode prefix
  ann[, contig_suffix := sub("^.*(_contig_\\d+)$", "\\1", contig_id)]
  ann[, contig_id := paste0(renamed_bc, contig_suffix)]

  # update sample from Seurat meta Identity using renamed barcode
  ann[, sample := unname(id_map[renamed_bc])]

  # optional: keep track of run
  ann[, run_id := run]

  # cleanup helper cols
  ann[, c("bc_base","sample_label","key","renamed_bc","contig_suffix") := NULL]

  # write per-run updated annotations
  data.table::fwrite(ann, out_annot)

  # merge across runs
  merged_annot <- if (is.null(merged_annot)) ann else data.table::rbindlist(list(merged_annot, ann), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

  # store run summary for merged QC summary
  all_run_summ[[run]] <- summ_out

  message("Processed run (FASTA + annotations + QC summary): ", run)
}

# =========================================================
# MERGED outputs
# =========================================================
merged_out_fa <- file.path(results_folder, "VDJ/Merged_Runs_all_contig.fasta")
if (anyDuplicated(names(merged_fasta)) > 0) {
  dn <- unique(names(merged_fasta)[duplicated(names(merged_fasta))])
  message("Duplicate contig names in MERGED FASTA (up to 50):")
  message(paste(head(dn, 50), collapse = "\n"))
  stop("Duplicate contig names detected in merged FASTA. Check renamed_bc uniqueness across runs.")
}
Biostrings::writeXStringSet(merged_fasta, merged_out_fa, format = "fasta", width = 80)
Rsamtools::indexFa(merged_out_fa)

merged_out_csv <- file.path(results_folder, "VDJ/Merged_Runs_all_contig_annotations.csv")
data.table::fwrite(merged_annot, merged_out_csv)

# merged QC summary across runs
merged_summ <- data.table::rbindlist(all_run_summ, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
merged_summ_out <- file.path(results_folder, "VDJ/Merged_Runs_qc_summary.csv")
data.table::fwrite(merged_summ, merged_summ_out)

list(
  merged_fasta = merged_out_fa,
  merged_annotations = merged_out_csv,
  merged_qc_summary = merged_summ_out
)

```
